faq: Will the articles sound like us?
Yes. We ask a few questions about your brand and customers, and read your existing pages. You review each draft and ask for edits before anything is published.
Do you use automatic text generators?
Articles are researched, written and edited by a person with an editor's check for accuracy. We do not publish text that has not been fact checked.
They can bring visitors who are comparing options, which is a useful audience. We cannot promise a number of sales, but we plan posts to lead people to the right product.
We upload them to your blog as drafts. You press publish, or you can ask us to set the date. You keep full control over what goes live.
